## How to read this

- **Topics / Concepts / Questions** come from the JSON pack.
- **+topup** is the subset of questions whose id contains `_topup_`
  — these were added in later bulk content passes; they're still
  scoped to a topic but use a non-sequential id.
- **HTML files** counts every `.html` in `Resources/Articles/Chapter<N>/`
  including `_overview` files. A concept without an HTML file falls back
  to a system text view; the test `testAllArticleHTMLFilesExistInBundle`
  asserts ≥ 90% coverage.
- **style.css** is the per-chapter article stylesheet — ✅ when present.
